question: The first Indian who won a medal in World Athletics Championship is_____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anju Bobby George**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anju Bobby George **won the **bronze medal** in **Long Jump** at the **2003 World Athletics Championships** held in **Paris, France**.
 
• Her historic achievement marked the **first time an Indian athlete won** a **medal **in a **World Athletics Championship **event.
 
• **Anju's **performance brought recognition and accolades to** Indian athletics on the global stage**.
 
• She is widely regarded as **one of India's greatest track and field athletes**, inspiring generations of athletes in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Neeraj Chopra**

 
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** is an **Indian track **and **field athlete** **specializing **in the **javelin throw.**
 
• He **made history** by **winning** the **gold medal** in the **men's javelin throw** at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**, becoming **India's first track** and **field Olympic champion**.
 
 
 
• **Murali Sreeshankar**
 
 
• ​**Indian athlete** specializing in **long jump**.
 
• Known for his accomplishments in the **field of athletics**.
 
 
 
• **Annu Rani**
 
 
• Indian athlete specializing in** javelin throwing**.
 
• Represented **India **in various** international competitions**.
 
• Holds the **national record **in **women's javelin throw**.
 
• Has won medals in **Asian Championships and other events**.
